title: Large Crate

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to transport items without the worry of items falling out

body:
"Crates can be used to store loose items and move them over long distances without accidently spilling them, this variant can hold a total of 8x8. Anchoring the crate will anchor everything inside of the crate automatically."


Description

The Large Crate costs $2,750 and can be found near the Lighthouse. When used, it'll allow you to carry items across the map without the worry of dropping items. It's the largest crate in the game.
